notes: Jewellery VAT 5% on full value (UAE Government portal: the VAT rate is 5%); investment precious metals (99%+, tradeable form) zero-rated (MoF Executive Regulation art. 36). Bar premiums removed in this pass: the only available reference was a dealer-published retail board rate, not a spot read on a primary page. Making % null: no dealer's own page states one.

sources.name: UAE Ministry of Finance - Executive Regulation of Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017 (Cabinet Decision No. 52 of 2017), Article 36
sources.what: Article 36: 'The supply or import of investment precious metals shall be zero-rated', where investment precious metals means gold, silver and platinum of a purity of 99 percent or more in a form tradeable in global bullion markets - gold and silver bullion VAT 0%.

sources.name: The Official Portal of the UAE Government - Value Added Tax (VAT)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: VAT was introduced on 1 Jan 2018 and the rate of VAT is 5 per cent - jewellery, which does not meet the investment-metal test, is taxed at 5%
sources.quote: Value Added Tax (VAT) was introduced in the UAE on 1 January 2018. The rate of VAT is 5 per cent.
